summary: Backend-only testing for Gesture Smart Home API. Created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_gesture_api.py) covering devices CRUD, level clamping (light 0-100, fan 1-5), reset, gesture events create/list/delete and stats aggregation. All 12 tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') are deprecated in favor of lifespan context managers. Works today but consider migrating.

Minor: GestureEvent.timestamp is stored as an isoformat string but the Pydantic response model expects datetime; code converts back on list. Consider storing as native datetime (Mongo supports it) to avoid conversion overhead and potential TZ-parse issues for older records.
Minor: DeviceUpdate has no validation on level type (accepts any int, even negative or huge). Clamping handles it, but adding Pydantic constraints would be cleaner.
Nit: /api/gesture-events limit is capped at 200 via to_list(200) but the cursor already limits; consistent min/max(1,200) logic is fine.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seed via GET /api/devices and POST /api/devices/reset verified; no manual seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 12 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_gesture_api.py cover all required backend endpoints. Uses fixture reset_state to clean devices/events before and after session. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_gesture_api.py -v
